programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie

programme.title: Naya Kadam

programme.title: Laila

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki

programme.title: Dhadkan

programme.title: Jug Jug Jeeyo
programme.desc: A family wedding becomes a backdrop for joy, romance, and celebration, but also exposes miscommunication, hidden affairs, and doubts that threaten to break marriages apart.

programme.title: Department
programme.desc: Inspector Mahadev recruits suspended officer Shiv Narayan for a hit squad, but when Shiv joins gangster-turned-minister Sarjerao Gaikwad, the two men become bitter adversaries.

programme.title: Sergeant
programme.desc: A dedicated police officer loses his leg during a risky mission but refuses to back down. He bravely puts his life on the line to solve a crucial unsolved murder case and seek justice.

programme.title: Nastik
programme.desc: Shankar loses his entire family to Tiger. Devastated, he turns atheist and sets out on a path of revenge, blaming God for the pain he cannot forget.

programme.title: Kachche Dhaage
programme.desc: Stepbrothers Aftab and Jai hate each other. Framed in a terrorism case, they must unite to prove their innocence and discover the strength hidden in brotherhood and trust.

programme.title: Billu
programme.desc: Billu, a poor barber, is suddenly treated with respect when villagers learn hes childhood friends with superstar Sahir Khan, who has come to their village for a film shoot.

programme.title: Partner
programme.desc: Love guru Prem guides his client Bhaskar to woo his boss, sharing dating tips. But Prem falls for a single mother and struggles to hide his profession, leading to unexpected complications.

programme.title: Ek Tha Tiger
programme.desc: RAW agent Tiger is sent to Dublin to monitor an Indian scientist suspected of leaking nuclear secrets. There, he meets Zoya, his caretaker, and falls for her, unaware of her dark secret.

programme.title: Bhediya
programme.desc: Bhaskar visits a small town with his cousin for work, but after a wolf attack, his life changes as he gains strange powers and struggles with his new werewolf identity.

programme.title: Masti
programme.desc: Three college friends, bored in their marriages, start extramarital affairs. Their fun turns dark when they become prime suspects in a murder, facing danger and suspicion.

programme.title: Ishk Actually
programme.desc: Gias life turns chaotic when her ex-lover Neil reappears, forcing her to confront her past and emotions. Through heartbreak and reflection, she learns that true happiness lies in following her heart.

programme.title: Chhota Bheem and the Curse of Damyaan
programme.desc: Bheem and his loyal friends set out on a perilous mission to defeat the evil demon Damyaan, risking everything to stop his sinister plans and save the world from destruction.

programme.title: Swades
programme.desc: Mohan, an Indian expatriate employed with NASA, travels to his country to track down his beloved nanny, Kaveri. During his stay, he finds himself advocating for reform in a village.

programme.title: Fool N Final
programme.desc: JD hires a bunch of bumbling thieves to steal a priceless diamond, but their mission spirals into chaos. Caught in a string of comic mishaps, they end up running from both the gem and JD himself.

programme.title: De Dana Dan
programme.desc: Two broke friends, eager to marry their girlfriends, hatch a plan to kidnap a rich womans pet for ransom, but their quick-money scheme soon spirals into chaos.

programme.title: Mere Yaar Ki Shaadi Hai
programme.desc: One morning, Sanjay learns his friend Anjali is marrying. His roommate Ria suspects love. Sanjay tries to ruin the wedding by turning Rohits family against him.

programme.desc: The eight home bakers who made it through the first round are taken to Scone Palace near Perth in Scotland to make biscuits and teatime treats. Two more bakers will be eliminated. S1, Ep2

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The six remaining bakers are challenged to make bread. Which of them will best cope with the pressure and who will be the one who has to leave the Bake Off? S1, Ep3

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The remaining bakers must reinvent an often-neglected British classic - the pudding. Judges Paul Hollywood and Mary Berry tests the contestants ability to cope with pressure. S1, Ep4

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The remaining bakers make their own versions of hearty British pies. Then judges Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood will decide who will be the final three to go through to the final. S1, Ep5

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: It is the Grand Final and the three surviving contestants must bake for the afternoon tea party. Who will be crowned the Great British Bake Offs Best Amateur Baker? S1, Ep6

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Cake. The 12 new bakers don their aprons and head for the iconic tent for cake week, starting with the signature challenge, to make the well-loved Madeira cake. S6, Ep1

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Biscuits. The remaining home bakers try to prove their skill at making 24 biscotti, and they tackle labour-intensive Arlettes in a tricky technical challenge. S6, Ep2

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Bread. The bakers must prepare quick breads with no proving, and a deceptively simple baguette - will they impress Paul Hollywood? Plus, showstopping action with 3D bread sculptures. S6, Ep3

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Desserts. The nine remaining bakers tackle creme brulee but will they be a scrambled mess? Plus, Spanische windtorte from Austria and baked cheesecake feature in the show-stopper. S6, Ep4

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Alternative Ingredients. The bakers must bake without sugar, gluten or dairy - but thankfully not all in the same challenge. Plus, things get sticky in Pauls technical challenge. S6, Ep5

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Pastry. Its time for the bakers to prove their pastry skills, and the technical challenge has them all treading carefully as they tackle the delicate world of puff pastry. S6, Ep6

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Victorian. Mary dusts off her antique cookbooks to find a technical recipe that dates back to the late 1800s, in an episode devoted entirely to the baking landscape of the Victorian era. S6, Ep7

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Patisserie. Its the quarter-finals, and the five remaining bakers work their way through childhood favourites and delicate French fancies to a mountainous choux pastry masterpiece. S6, Ep8

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Chocolate. Week nine, and that can only mean one thing, its the semi-finals. The pressure is on as the bakers get to grips with one of the most difficult ingredients - chocolate. S6, Ep9

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The Final. Its the final, and Mary and Paul are expecting nothing short of perfection. Who will hold their nerve and be crowned winner of this years Great British Bake Off? S6, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Smoked, Grilled And Fried. This trip, Guy is all about meat. In Miami hes joined by Charles Johnson and they try a charcuterie dishing up wild boar sausage and house-cured bacon. S24, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Hot Meat And Cool Veg. Guy fires up some meaty meals and veggie specials. In Modesto, Portuguese sausage and lamb burgers and in Oakland, theres outrageous vegan okra gumbo. S24, Ep8

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Pizza Plus. Guy Fieri is diving into the pie! He starts in Boston to check out a beer-crust pizza, and he visits a funky joint serving a twist on apple pie in Reno, NV. S30, Ep14

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: International Intrigue. Guy Fieri traverses the US, grabbing international eats from Thai in Texas to Ethiopian in Arizona. And, he visits a Latin place serving empanadas in Miami. S28, Ep6

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Chicken And Ribs. Guy Fieri samples sauced-up chicken tacos in California! Then, its moms mouth-watering pasta in Florida, and over-the-top Thai creations in Las Vegas. S37, Ep1

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Meat And Sweet. Guy Fieri seeks meat with a little sweet. In Santa Barbara, he visits a hidden gem serving Korean paella, then he visits a Boca Raton food truck. S37, Ep2

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Detroit. Adam Richman visits Detroit, Michigan for the massive Triple Threat Pork sandwich, two duelling Coney Dog joints, and the worlds biggest burger! S2, Ep15

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Philadelphia. Adam heads to Philadelphia, Pennsylvania for an Italian roast pork sandwich, a mega ice cream concoction known as Mt. Vesuvius, and the Ultimate Cheesesteak Challenge. S2, Ep17

programme.desc: Family: Join Sir David Attenborough as he zooms in on a set of bugs who prefer cooperation to conflict, from the burrowing cockroach to a queen bee. (Ep 5 of 6)

programme.title: David Attenborough: Micro Monsters
programme.desc: Colony: Before departing the insect world, Sir David Attenborough takes a tour of its vast colonies, which rival human megacities in both size and complexity. (Ep 6 of 6)

programme.title: David Attenboroughs Conquest of the Skies
programme.desc: First to Fly: Sir David Attenborough charts the story of animals who defy gravity, starting with the first flyers: the insect. (Ep 1 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenboroughs Conquest of the Skies
programme.desc: Rivals: After meeting some critters who glide through life in Borneo, Sir David Attenborough turns back the clock. (Ep 2 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenboroughs Conquest of the Skies
programme.desc: Triumph: In the final episode, Sir David Attenborough turns his attention to the creatures that dominate our skies today. (Ep 3 of 3)

programme.title: Worlds Most Toxic Animals
programme.desc: Deserts and Oceans: In Australia, meet the worlds most venomous snake. Plus, in nearby oceans, discover the deadly nature of the marine creatures that share these tropical waters. (1 of 2)

programme.title: Worlds Most Toxic Animals
programme.desc: Forest and Grasslands: In the South American rainforest, theres a tiny frog thats packed with poison. While near Sydney, Australia, youll meet the worlds most venomous spider. (2 of 2)

programme.title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
programme.desc: Hunters and Hunted: Follow great grey owls, kangaroo rats and more as they use sound to hunt and survive. (1 of 3)

programme.title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
programme.desc: Finding a Voice: Follow baby animals as they learn to communicate to survive, using sound to call for help in their early days. (3 of 3)

programme.title: Attenboroughs Journey
programme.desc: A look back at Sir David Attenboroughs incredible life and career in broadcasting, including his youth as a fossil hunter and his pioneering use of technologies such as 3D and 4K.

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef With David Attenborough
programme.desc: Builders: David Attenborough descends beneath the waves and meets some of the tiny coral animals that helped build the Reef and make it an underwater wonderland. (1 of 3)

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef With David Attenborough
programme.desc: Visitors: Sir David Attenborough continues exploring the Great Barrier Reef, and discovers the animals that visit every year - some travelling thousands of miles. (2 of 3)

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef With David Attenborough
programme.desc: Survival: In this concluding episode, Sir David Attenborough tries to understand what the next few decades may hold in store for the Reef. (3 of 3)

programme.title: Attenboroughs Flying Monsters
programme.desc: David Attenborough embarks on a journey into the past to explore the ancient world of the pterosaur, a remarkable flying monster that ruled the skies 200 million years ago.
